Love Calculator

Enter two names to get a playful compatibility score from 0 to 100. The result is deterministic — the same pair of names always gets the same score.

–
Compatibility

Just for fun — not scientifically accurate (obviously).

📖 How to use

  1. Type the first name in the first input box.
  2. Type the second name in the second input box.
  3. Click "Calculate Love" to reveal the compatibility score.
  4. Read the playful message that matches your score tier.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Is the Love Calculator scientifically accurate?

No, it is purely for entertainment. The score comes from a simple deterministic hash of the two names, not from any psychological or scientific model.

Will I get the same score if I enter the same names again?

Yes. The score is computed from a fixed hash of the two names, so entering the same pair of names again will always produce the same percentage.

Does capitalization or spacing matter?

Yes, mostly — the name strings are normalized (trimmed and lowercased), so extra spaces or capital letters do not change the result.
